entry.author: Ministry for Ethnic Communities
entry.summary:
More than 450 people from throughout New Zealand’s business community joined the Ministry for Ethnic Communities’ Ethnic Xchange business symposium (EX25).  

Discover what the event meant to participants, speakers, and sponsors – the power of the connections made, the opportunities unlocked, and why Ethnic Xchange is helping drive economic growth.
